messages:
Maya: Thinking about hosting a tiny backyard hang Saturday night — firepit, marshmallows, blankets. Anyone up for it? :fire: 
Tony: Firepit sounds perfect. I can bring chili and a 12-pack. :point_right: :taco: 
Olivia: Ooh tempting, but there's a new brewery crawl starting downtown Saturday evening… Hops & Rails has a flight special. :beers: 
Sam: Brewery for me — allergic to smoke so outdoor-only places or breweries please :sneezing_face: 
Maya: @Sam totally — my yard is smoke-managed and I can keep the pit low. Porch seating for the sneeze-squad. :grin: 
Tony: What time? I was thinking 7pm for firepit. Brewery crawl starts around 6:30, ends whenever. 
Olivia: If we do brewery, maybe meet at Hops & Rails at 7 and then wander? They have a good patio. 
Dev-Bot: Reminder: RSVP for social events in the #rnd-social RSVP form. Link posted every time someone types "party" :robot_face: 
Maya: Link: https://tiny.redwood.social/rsvp (added marshmallow allergy checkbox) 
Sam: Can we do a quick show-of-hands? Firepit = :fire:, Brewery = :beers: — react and I'll tally. 
Olivia: :beers: (me) 
Tony: :fire: (me) 
Maya: :fire:  — kids and dog-friendly at my place if that matters. :dog: 
Sam: :beers: — patio > smoke for me. 
Olivia: If brewery wins I can coordinate the route and check for outdoor seating + reservations. 
Tony: Also voting factor: I can only stay until 10pm if it's a weeknight. Saturday night I'm good. 
Maya: Saturday's great. If it's split we could do a hybrid — early drinks at brewery then head to my place later? 
Olivia: Not a bad plan. Brewery first, then mellow at Maya's firepit? 
Sam: Works for me. Less smoke exposure and still get s'mores. Win-win. :smile: 
Maya: I'll bring extra chairs, blankets, and a ukulele if anyone wants to attempt campfire songs. :guitar: 
Tony: I'll text-arrange a cooler and the chili. Anyone want to volunteer for dessert other than marshmallows? 
Olivia: I got cookies. Also I'll DM logistics/ETA and coordinate rides. 
Sam: Thanks! Also — can someone bring bug spray? My mosquito defense is weak. :mosquito: 
Maya: Yep, I'll have spray and citronella candles. 
Olivia: OK looks like majority leans toward brewery first then firepit. I'll make a mini poll in the #random thread later to lock details. 
Tony: Perfect. See y'all Saturday. 
Maya: RSVP in the form and ping me if you need the address. :house: 
Dev-Bot: Note: if attendance >12, consider parking plan. Parking map: /assets/parking-map.png (auto-post)
Sam: Thanks everyone! Excited :)
